def main():
    # Disable synchronization with C standard I/O for faster input
    sys.stdin = open(0, 'r')
    
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    
    v = []
    
    for _ in range(n):
        val = int(sys.stdin.readline())

    v.sort()
